title: Constant speed condition
description: Essential: The solution must state or apply that net force parallel to the incline is zero due to constant velocity.

title: Force balance parallel
description: Important: Correctly writes the force balance equation along the incline: friction + mg sinθ = qE cosθ.

title: Force balance perpendicular
description: Important: Correctly writes the force balance equation normal to the incline: mg cosθ + qE sinθ = normal force.

title: Friction definition
description: Important: Applies the kinetic friction law: friction force = μ * normal force.

title: Final expression for μ
description: Essential: Derives and presents the final symbolic answer μ = (qE cosθ - mg sinθ) / (mg cosθ + qE sinθ).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns direction/sign to electric or gravitational force components along the incline.

title: Normal force omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include the electric field's component (qE sinθ) in the normal force balance.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Notes or verifies that the final expression for μ is dimensionless.
